newsitem.title: USA: Adams Resources says Robinson well a success.
newsitem.headline: Adams Resources says Robinson well a success.

text.p: Adams Resources & Enregy Inc said Wednesday it successfully completed its Robinson 2-H well located on the Giddings Field on the Turkey Creek Prospect in Grimes Country, Texas, with the well testing at an initial rate of 21.8 millon cubic feet of gas per day.
Adams holds a 25 percent interest in the well, Nuevo Energy Co holds 50 percent and the remainder is privately held.
The Robinson 2-H well is the fifth successful well in Turkey Creek Prospect, said the company. Adams said that a sixth Turkey Creek well should be finished in early March.
